most_important_boundaries: CCF StructureTree is a rebuildable resolved semantic IR, not a second canonical SSOT.
CW derives entity dependencies only from explicit dependency-forming Link Rulesets, not every visual/textual link.
CW READY is canonical-model completeness, not implementation correctness, real hardware suitability or runtime behavior.
Source code mapper is an allowed CCF import path, not proof a complete production mapper is present.

No individual dependency version solver is needed for AIGMos pruning of one coherent source snapshot, but canonical specification_ref/format-version interpretation still requires immutable version pinning.
No direct generation from prose-only developer documents; first structure them into explicit Entity/Property semantics with pinned interpretation specification.
No silent change of historical source header MP=both when adding target BOTH.
recommended_order: M1: Produce full 1.9 CCF candidate from current decision/feature inventory with explicit Gaps; map each decision to entity/property/constraint and provenance.
M2: Run CCF/CW shape/readiness on candidate, distinguish INVALID vs UNREADY; do not assume validated before actual tests.
M3: Resolve only semantics not derivable: component /config+BOOT/RELOAD/AC privilege, HC CS/TER ABI, 1.8 parity divergences, module 1.9 lifecycle adaptation.
M4: Import CW CodeMarkup ruleset when ready; apply versioned MP/CP/BOTH and conditional-dependency handling.
M5: Generate registry/closure/profile field catalog from structured metadata; hand-decide only profile file format and target packaging.
M6: Run implementation correspondence, security, parity and C6 real-device tests; lock only passing artifacts.
